name: zombieplague
description: Zombie Plague for Garry's Mod — incremental TypeScript migration

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tests/client-types/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build:check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
